title: Sign in with a staging test session
Chat with May and get a reply
goal: In May Playground, open Chats and start a new chat with May. Send this message: This is device test {tag}. Reply with one short sentence. Then wait until May's reply appears under your message.

title: Add a note to an agenda item
goal: In May Playground, open Agenda and open the first item you see. Open its Notes tab and add a note that says: {tag} note from the device test. Make sure the note is saved and shown.

title: Answer May's multiple-choice question
goal: In May Playground, open Chats and start a new chat with May. Send this message: Ask me a multiple-choice question about my week, tag {tag}. When May shows a question card with choices, tap one of the choices. Then wait until the card shows your choice as the answer.

title: Skip May's question with a free reply
goal: In May Playground, open Chats and start a new chat with May. Send this message: Ask me a multiple-choice question about my week, tag {tag}. When May shows a question card with choices, do not tap any choice. Instead type and send this message: I will answer in my own words, {tag}. Then check that the question card now shows as skipped, with its choices dimmed.
